notes: Accessors compared as deinterleaved component payload bytes plus type/count/normalization; numeric accessor/material IDs ignored.
Material properties compare resolved embedded image hashes and sampler properties, as well as assignments by material name.
All original node local transforms, named mesh references and parent/child relationships compared.
Additional export material entries may duplicate existing names; no new texture payloads or material names are implied.
This binary geometry audit does not establish native framebuffer coverage, visual approval or runtime performance.

diagnostics.interpretation: Every original POSITION and NORMAL accessor payload is exact; UV payload changes, sphere triangulation index changes and material property/texCoord changes prevent an exact-preservation claim.
diagnostics.recommended_repair: Retain the checkpoint GLB as the base; append only the14 new Overscan meshes/nodes and their geometry buffers, remapping new material slots to original names. This preserves the original published UV fixes, material properties and triangulation.
